texts.preamble: K.P.Manish Global vs The Director (Imports) on 26 July, 2016 Author: T.S.Sivagnanam Bench: T.S.Sivagnanam In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras Dated :: 26.7.2016 Coram: The Honourable Mr.Justice T.S.Sivagnanam W.P.No.17685 of 2016 K.P.Manish Global Ingredients Pvt ltd Rep by its Authorized Representative Mr.P.Deepak Jain ... petitioner versus 1 The Director (Imports) Food Safety and Standards Authority of India Ministry of Health and Family Welfare Fda Bhawan Kotla Road New Delhi-110 002 2 The Authorized Officer Food Safety & Standards Authority of India Ministry of Health & Family Welfare Southern Regional Office Ii Floor Rajaji Salai Chennai-01 3 Commissioner of Customs Customs House No.60 Rajaji Salai Chennai- 600 001 ... respondents Writ Petition filed under Art.226 of the Constitution of India praying for a Writ of Cer For petitioner ... Mr.K.Surendranath For respondents ... Mr.Yasmin Ali, for respondents 1 and 2 Mr.V.Sundareswaran, for R-3 O R D E R
texts.facts: 3. The petitioner has filed this Writ Petition challenging the rejection of their request for re-sampling and retesting of Whey powder. When the matter was heard for admission on 13.5.2016, the prayer for interim relief sought for by the petitioner was considered in W.M.P.Nos.15390 and 15391 of 2016. The petitioner sought for a direction to respondents 1 and 2 to take fresh samples from the consignment imported by them under two bills of entries and send the same for testing, in the presence of the authorized representative of the petitioner and at the cost of the petitioner and to place the report before this Court. The other prayer in the interim application was to shift the consignment to a private refrigerator warehouse. Both these miscellaneous petitions were allowed by common order dated 13.5.2016 and the samples were drawn and sent to the laboratory for testing and its report has been received and it has been produced before this Court by the learned counsel for the second respondent in a sealed cover. 5. Though the prayer sought for by the petitioner was to place the report before this Court, this Court is of the view that since the matter involves technical aspects, it is for the second respondent to pass a fresh order, based upon the said report.
